{{Current events|year=2019|month=02|day=25|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[American military intervention in Somalia (2007–present)]]
**[[United States Africa Command]] says a [[United States|U.S.]] airstrike has killed 35 [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] militants in [[Somalia]]'s central [[Hiran, Somalia|Hiran]] administrative region. [https://www.france24.com/en/20190225-us-strike-somalia-kills-35-terrorists-pentagon (FRANCE 24)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Piper PA-46 Malibu crash]]
**The [[Air Accidents Investigation Branch]] of the [[United Kingdom]] issues an interim report revealing the pilot, David Ibbotson, held only a private pilots licence and could not transport paying passengers within the [[European Union]]. Ibbotson and [[Argentina|Argentinian]] [[football (soccer)|footballer]] [[Emiliano Sala]] both died in the accident. [[Cardiff City FC]] announce "grave concerns" over Ibbotson's licence. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-wales-47358572 (BBC)]
;International relations
*[[Chagos Archipelago sovereignty dispute]]
**The [[International Court of Justice]] (ICJ), the highest court of the [[United Nations]], rules that the [[United Kingdom]] should end its control of the [[Chagos Archipelago]] "as rapidly as possible". [[Mauritius]] claims the archipelago was unlawfully separated from the [[island nation]] in 1965. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-47358602 (BBC)]
*[[Brexit]]
**The [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]] announces it will support a second referendum on the end of the [[United Kingdom]]'s membership of the [[European Union]] unless Wednesday sees Labour's proposed Brexit deal supported by Parliament. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-47363307 (BBC)]
*[[Negotiations between the Taliban and the United States]]
**Peace talks begin in [[Qatar]] between the [[United States]] and the [[Taliban]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-47351369 (BBC)]
*[[2019 North Korea–United States Hanoi Summit]]
**[[List of leaders of North Korea|North Korean leader]] [[Kim Jong-un]] arrives in [[Vietnam]], ahead of his two-day summit with [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] in the capital [[Hanoi]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/02/25/asia/kim-jong-un-vietnam-arrive-train-intl/index.html (CNN)]

;Law and crime
*[[United Kingdom|UK]] [[Home Secretary]] [[Sajid Javid]] announces plans to ban the political wing of the [[Lebanon|Lebanese]] Islamist movement [[Hezbollah]] under [[Terrorism Acts|counterterrorism legislation]]. [https://www.heraldscotland.com/news/17457501.hezbollah-to-be-completely-banned-in-britain-under-anti-terror-laws/ (Herald Scotland)]
*[[Iran and state-sponsored terrorism]]
**Police in [[Kenya]] ask a court to allow them to detain three men for 30 days on suspicion of conspiring to aid two [[Iran]]ian terror suspects to escape. [http://www.kbc.co.ke/police-probe-plot-terror-suspects-escape/ (KBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Okinawan referendum]]
**[[Prime Minister of Japan|Japanese Prime Minister]] [[Shinzō Abe]] says the [[relocation of Marine Corps Air Station Futenma]], in the [[Okinawa Prefecture]], will still go ahead despite 72% of Okinawan voters rejecting the construction of a new base in a non-binding referendum. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-47353504 (BBC)]
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**[[Jorge Ramos (news anchor)|Jorge Ramos]] and five other [[Univision]] staff are detained at [[Miraflores Palace]] in [[Caracas]] shortly after interviewing [[Nicolás Maduro]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/02/25/media/univision-venezuela-jorge-ramos/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.miamiherald.com/news/nation-world/world/americas/venezuela/article226785924.html (Miami Herald)]
*[[2019 Cuban constitutional referendum]]
**Voters in [[Cuba]] approve a new constitution which recognizes private and cooperative businesses, sets term limits for the president, creates the post of [[prime minister]], introduces the [[presumption of innocence]] and [[habeas corpus]] to the justice system, and affirms an "irrevocable" socialist government. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/02/cubans-approve-constitution-affirming-role-socialism-190226002347961.html (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/feb/25/cuba-approves-new-socialist-constitution (The Guardian)]

;Sports
*[[New England Patriots]] owner [[Robert Kraft]] is charged with two counts of first-degree solicitation in [[Florida]]. [http://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/26078163/patriots-owner-robert-kraft-officially-charged-first-degree-solicitation-prostitute (ESPN)] [https://www.npr.org/2019/02/25/697782148/robert-kraft-is-formally-charged-with-solicitation-over-visits-to-florida-day-sp (NPR)] [https://www.foxnews.com/sports/patriots-robert-kraft-allegedly-visited-florida-spa-for-sex-acts-on-day-of-afc-championship-game (Fox News)]
